messages:
alex.miller: Quick sync on the ACME private deployment outage follow-ups. Postmortem had three recurring themes: VPC peering fragility, on-prem MTU/BGP quirks, and a service isolation bug that caused partial cache eviction. Need clear owners + runbook changes.
rebecca_sre: +1. I started a short list of remediation workstreams in the doc, but want to lock owners and SLAs. Can we do owners now?
mike_runtime: I can take the runbook + isolation-detection rule. I'll add a deterministic health-check that monitors cross-AZ VPC route convergence and KV cache miss spikes.
samir_ml: I can own the cache fallback / graceful-degradation change in the runtime model adapter. ETA: spike by next Wed, PR by end of sprint.
laura_cs: Noted for customer comms. ACME expects a remediation timeline for Dedicated and Private next week. Please add expected sign-off dates.
alex.miller: Owner matrix proposal: Mike -> runbook & alerting (14 days), Samir -> runtime graceful-degrade (10 days), Rebecca -> infra hardening plan (21 days), Laura -> customer comms & verification (14 days). Anyone object?
rebecca_sre: Fine. I'll schedule the infra review and start a peering configuration audit. Also opening tickets for MTU checks and BGP session monitoring.
ops-bot: New issue created: RD-INC-4982 - peering-audit-for-acme (assigned: rebecca_sre)
mike_runtime: Runbook snippet I'll add (WIP):
```
# Isolation detection runbook - v0.2
Triggers:
  - >3 peering route withdraws within 5 minutes
  - KV cache miss rate > 8% for 60s
Checks to run:
  1) `ip route show` on peered node+control plane reachability test
  2) probe BGP session state via SNMP/BGP API
Mitigation steps:
  a) Restart peering agent on affected node (`systemctl restart rdp-peering`), collect logs
  b) If BGP flaps, escalate to neteng & apply temporary route-blackhole rule
  c) Fallback: route traffic to compatible model variant in a different region
Post-incident: open tracing span for all requests during window
```
samir_ml: Suggest adding a step to rehydrate KV cache from readonly snapshot before fallback. Otherwise we risk quality regressions.
mike_runtime: Good call. I'll add pre-fallback rehydrate with rate-limited warmup.
rebecca_sre: For on-prem constraints: we saw MTU mismatch + aggressive TCP retransmit causing slow route convergence. Action: re-run MTU discovery across customer boxes, add MTU mismatch alert. Ticket RD-ENG-731 created.
laura_cs: I'm putting together the customer-facing timeline: initial mitigation done, in-progress fixes (runbook + infra audit), expected completion date: {14 days from 1790124680 -> 179123], will confirm exact epoch when owners post PRs}. Will send preliminary note tomorrow.
alex.miller: We should also capture recurring incident pattern: similar peering flaps for two other customers in quarter. Proposal: bi-weekly "peering-health" sweep owned by infra until we have automation. Rebecca, can you take a 3-month rotation schedule?
rebecca_sre: Yes. I'll create a calendar and recurring ticket with checklist. Also adding a post-deploy smoke test for private peering changes.
ops-bot: Reminder: RCA doc link posted: https://redwood.example/rca/acme-2026-03 (access: teams/redwood/acme)
mike_runtime: I'll aim to ship runbook PR by 1790200000 and alerting rule by 1790190000. Samir, can you confirm runtime PR window?
samir_ml: Targeting 1790188000 for the runtime spike and 1790240000 for the PR merge (depends on review).
laura_cs: Customer sync scheduled Thu 15:00 PT. I'll include the timeline and owners. Please post PR links before then.
alex.miller: Final ask: add explicit rollback criteria and a quick test plan to the runbook. If runbook + alerts are in by owners' dates, we'll call this remediated and schedule a 30-day follow-up audit.
rebecca_sre: Adding rollback criteria now.
mike_runtime: Added test plan + rollback steps in the runbook PR (link forthcoming).
laura_cs: Ack. I'll confirm ACME sign-off after Thursday sync.
alex.miller: Great work. I'll create a tracking board with columns: To Do / In Progress / Awaiting Customer / Done and link tickets. Everyone assigned, please update status daily until resolved. :thumbsup:
